description: SwiftLogix Module 4 given sample: 4 origin zones x 4 hub corridors x 4 destination zones

demand_D.meaning: D[i][k] = forecast parcel volume (hundreds of parcels/day) from origin zone i routed via hub corridor k

cost_C.meaning: C[k][j] = cost (Rs thousand per hundred parcels) to move parcels from hub corridor k to destination zone j

product_meaning: F = D x C, F[i][j] = forecast network cost (Rs thousand/day) attributable to origin i and destination j
